# BeyondRGB WebSocket 1-liner tests — port 9500
# Requires: pip install websocket-client
# Each sends a request, prints response type, and formats any stack trace

# Helper: recv all responses (JSON + binary), print formatted trace on error
# Usage: copy the _h() helper first, then run any test line

# 1. 16-bit TIFF (expected: success — native format)
python3 -c "
import websocket,json,sys
ws=websocket.create_connection('ws://localhost:9500');ws.settimeout(10)
ws.send(json.dumps({'RequestID':1,'RequestType':'HalfSizePreview','RequestData':{'names':['/home/h02332/work/copilot/pr-418/test-corpus/fuzzed_image_16bit_depth.tiff']}}))
resps=[]
try:
 while True:
  r=ws.recv()
  try: resps.append(json.loads(r))
  except: resps.append({'_binary':True,'_size':len(r)})
except: pass
for r in resps:
 if isinstance(r,dict) and r.get('ResponseType')=='Error':
  d=r.get('ResponseData',{});print(f\"ERROR: {d.get('message','')}\");t=d.get('trace','')
  if t:
   for line in t.split('\n'): print(f'  {line}')
 elif isinstance(r,dict) and r.get('_binary'): print(f\"OK: received {r['_size']} bytes binary data\")
 else: print(f\"RESP: {json.dumps(r,indent=2)[:400]}\")
ws.close()
"

# 10. Process pipeline (full calibration request with two images)
python3 -c "
import websocket,json
ws=websocket.create_connection('ws://localhost:9500');ws.settimeout(15)
ws.send(json.dumps({'RequestID':10,'RequestType':'Process','RequestData':{'batch':False,'images':[{'art':'/home/h02332/work/copilot/pr-418/test-corpus/fuzzed_image_16bit_depth.tiff','white':'/home/h02332/work/copilot/pr-418/test-corpus/fuzzed_image_standard_rgb.tiff','dark':''}],'outputFileName':'ws_test_10','destinationDirectory':'/tmp/fuzz_out'}}))
resps=[]
try:
 while True:
  r=ws.recv()
  try: resps.append(json.loads(r))
  except: resps.append({'_binary':True,'_size':len(r)})
except: pass
for r in resps:
 if isinstance(r,dict) and r.get('ResponseType')=='Error':
  d=r.get('ResponseData',{});print(f\"ERROR: {d.get('message','')}\");t=d.get('trace','')
  if t:
   for line in t.split('\n'): print(f'  {line}')
 elif isinstance(r,dict) and r.get('_binary'): print(f\"OK: received {r['_size']} bytes binary data\")
 else: print(f\"RESP: {json.dumps(r,indent=2)[:400]}\")
ws.close()
"
